annotations.title: Start the AI receptionist from a type of business

description: Starts one AI receptionist, named by id, from a type of business (setup, the key the list of types of business gives). It fills the persona’s what_you_do, tone and may_quote_prices, replaces the procedures with the setup’s, and keeps a clinic to booking. The business name, links and the rest of the persona are kept. Every field stays editable: the persona, the procedures, and the receptionist’s own settings, which can take the setup’s urgent words and closed message. Each apply needs a confirmed call: without confirmation_token the call is a preview that returns what would happen and a token for a person to approve. Owners and admins.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

setup.description: A type of business, by its `key`.
